note: Verbatim acceptance scenarios. humanReview is empty until an expert reviews it; model output is never a label.

story.title: Accept a valid report without keeping the child's national ID

scenarios.given: a report for a child Person knows, with valid hours, dates within the open period and valid absence codes
scenarios.then: it is accepted, stored against the child's M2LB identity with BirkID and reporter, and the child's fødselsnummer/DUF-nummer is not stored, published or logged.

story.title: Accept a valid report without keeping the child's national ID

scenarios.given: a report where `AntallTimerFaktiskNaervaer` is greater than `AntallTimerEtterPlanen`
scenarios.then: it is accepted and flagged "attendance above plan", and the absence-sum check is not applied to it.

story.title: Accept a valid report without keeping the child's national ID

scenarios.given: a report whose absence hours sum differs from planned minus actual hours by more than 0.5 hours
scenarios.then: it is accepted and flagged "inconsistent hour totals".

story.title: Accept a valid report without keeping the child's national ID

scenarios.given: the same message delivered twice
scenarios.then: nothing changes and the same outcome is returned.

story.title: Accept a valid report without keeping the child's national ID

scenarios.given: a report with an hour value greater than 24 × the number of days in its date range
scenarios.then: it is rejected with a machine-readable reason.

story.title: Process reports for security-classified children and enforce gradering on access

scenarios.given: a report for a child Person returns as Kode 6 or Kode 7
scenarios.then: it is validated, stored and versioned like any other report, the child's gradering is not stored, and it is answered as received.

story.title: Process reports for security-classified children and enforce gradering on access

scenarios.given: stored data for a Kode 6/7 child
scenarios.when: a user without `Person:SeGradertBarn` for that child reads any list or lookup
scenarios.then: the child does not appear and is not counted, and a direct lookup answers as if the child did not exist.

story.title: Lock the period and deliver one final dataset

scenarios.given: accepted reports in an open period
scenarios.then: the period locks and one dataset is produced containing one row per accepted report with BirkID, period, report dates, reporter type and identity, planned and actual hours, absence lines, source `ALTINN` and quality flags, except reports for children who are Kode 6/7 at lock (User Story 2).

story.title: Lock the period and deliver one final dataset

scenarios.given: a locked period
scenarios.when: the lock or export is run again
scenarios.then: the result is identical and nothing changes.

story.title: Hold reports for children not yet known

scenarios.given: a report whose identifier Person cannot resolve
scenarios.then: it is answered as received and held, the identifier and the report content are stored encrypted together with their own access control, and the lookup is retried when Person reports a new or changed person and at a fixed interval.

story.title: Hold reports for children not yet known

scenarios.given: a held report
scenarios.when: the child becomes resolvable before lock
scenarios.then: the report is processed as in User Stories 1 and 2 and the held identifier is deleted.

story.title: Corrections, withdrawals and more than one reporter

scenarios.given: an accepted report
scenarios.when: the same reporter sends a correction (`Oppdatering`) within the window
scenarios.then: a new version replaces the previous one, and the previous version is kept as history.

story.title: Corrections, withdrawals and more than one reporter

scenarios.given: reports from two different reporters for the same child and period
scenarios.then: both are delivered as separate rows, each with its reporter and flagged "multiple reporters".

story.title: Expected population and coverage breakdown

scenarios.given: a child placed in a foster home (any type) or a private institution for at least one day of the period, of compulsory school age (grades 1–10), and with an utdanningsforhold overlapping the period
scenarios.then: the child is expected.

story.title: Expected population and coverage breakdown

scenarios.given: a child placed only in a state institution during the period
scenarios.then: the child is not expected (the state channel reports through BiRK).

story.title: Maintain education master data

scenarios.given: a new utdanningsforhold whose child reference Person resolves
scenarios.then: it is stored linked to the child's M2LB identity with from–to, education type and school type, and the child reference is not kept.

story.title: Maintain education master data

scenarios.given: an existing record
scenarios.when: an update or an end/delete is ingested
scenarios.then: the record changes or ends, and the previous state remains readable for past periods.

story.title: Keep education relations and missing school offers current

scenarios.given: a new utdanningsforhold in BiRK
scenarios.then: SkoleService receives a create with a stable record identity, the child reference, from date, to date (or open-ended), education type and school type in SkoleService's code lists.

story.title: Keep education relations and missing school offers current

scenarios.given: a new manglende skoletilbud
scenarios.then: SkoleService receives a create with record identity, child reference, from date, to date and reason in SkoleService's code list.

story.title: Forward every row with the child reference; never resolve or guess identity

scenarios.given: a row whose child is unknown to Person
scenarios.then: it is forwarded with its child reference like any other row.

story.title: Forward every row with the child reference; never resolve or guess identity

scenarios.given: a row whose child is Kode 6 or Kode 7
scenarios.then: it is forwarded like any other row, and no classification is stored, logged or counted by the adapter.

story.title: Deletes and ends reach SkoleService

scenarios.given: a forwarded row
scenarios.then: SkoleService receives a delete for the same record identity.

story.title: Search for Children

scenarios.given: a caseworker with `Person:SøkBarn` for an org unit
scenarios.then: they receive a paginated summary list containing only children in that org unit at security level 0 or 1, within acceptable response time.

story.title: Search for Children

scenarios.given: a caseworker with `Person:SeGradertBarn` for a specific Kode 6 child
scenarios.when: they search by that child's name
scenarios.then: the child appears in results with a clear address-protection flag indicating the address must not be disclosed.

story.title: View Child Profile

scenarios.given: a caseworker with `Person:SeBarnGrunnprofil`
scenarios.then: they see: Name, BirkId, BarnType, BarnStatusType, Municipality, security level, and data source. National ID is masked.

story.title: View Child Profile

scenarios.given: a caseworker with `Person:SeFullIdentitet` for a child
scenarios.then: the full national ID (fødselsnummer/DUF) is shown unmasked.

story.title: Manage Access to Kode 6/7 Children

scenarios.given: a user with `Person:AdministerGradertBarntilgang` for a Kode 6/7 child
scenarios.when: they grant another named user access via the Person module
scenarios.then: the Person module validates pre-conditions (child exists, is classified, no self-assignment) and calls the Authorisation module to create the grant; the new access appears in the access list.

story.title: Continuous Person Data Synchronization

scenarios.given: a new person record is created in BiRK
scenarios.then: the person exists in PersonModule with identity fields (name, national ID, date of birth, DUF number) correctly mapped from BiRK values.

story.title: Continuous Person Data Synchronization

scenarios.given: an existing person's data is updated in BiRK
scenarios.then: PersonModule reflects the updated data.

story.title: Child Registration Synchronization

scenarios.given: a child registration is created in BiRK
scenarios.then: the registration exists in PersonModule with BirkID, registration type, status, and municipality correctly mapped.

story.title: Child Registration Synchronization

scenarios.given: a child registration has a composite status value (e.g., "Bestilling/Under Behandling")
scenarios.then: the value is preserved in PersonModule unchanged — no splitting or transformation.

story.title: Saksbehandler ser tjenesteoversikt for et barn

scenarios.given: a child has two active placements registered in the system
scenarios.when: a case worker queries for that child's services
scenarios.then: both placements are returned, sorted with the most recent first, each including type, status, and all relevant dates.

story.title: Saksbehandler ser tjenesteoversikt for et barn

scenarios.given: a child has no registered services
scenarios.when: a case worker queries for that child's services
scenarios.then: an empty list is returned — not an error.

story.title: Saksbehandler ser detaljer for én tjeneste

scenarios.given: a placement exists with a known identifier and is fully linked to a child
scenarios.when: a case worker queries for that specific placement
scenarios.then: all fields are returned with correct values, and optional fields not set are returned as empty rather than errors.

story.title: Saksbehandler ser detaljer for én tjeneste

scenarios.given: a placement identifier that does not exist
scenarios.when: a case worker queries for it
scenarios.then: an empty result is returned — not an error.

story.title: Translate Non-Domain Identifiers to English

scenarios.given: an internal service class currently named `TilgangsEvalueringService`
scenarios.then: the class is renamed to `AccessEvaluationService` and all internal references are updated. (Internal class — not part of the public API surface.)

story.title: Translate Non-Domain Identifiers to English

scenarios.given: a GraphQL response type property named `BrukerIdentifikator` or a Service Bus event field named `KorrelasjonsId`
scenarios.then: both are left unchanged (serialized surface — do not rename).

story.title: Domain Term Inventory Is Agreed and Documented

scenarios.given: the codebase contains a Norwegian identifier
scenarios.when: a developer consults the domain term list
scenarios.then: the identifier is present with a classification (preserve / translate-to) and a short rationale.

story.title: Domain Term Inventory Is Agreed and Documented

scenarios.given: the domain term list is finalized
scenarios.when: a reviewer checks a translated file
scenarios.then: every preserved term matches the list and every translated term does not appear on the "preserve" list.

story.title: All Tests Pass After Translation

scenarios.given: the translation is complete
scenarios.when: the full test suite is executed
scenarios.then: all tests pass (zero failures, zero errors).

story.title: Deliver a valid skolenærvær message to SkoleService

scenarios.given: a valid skolenærvær v2.0.1 message
scenarios.then: SkoleService receives one request containing the child's identifier and its type, the reporter's type and identity, period dates, planned and actual hours, absence lines, message id, send time and message-chain information.

story.title: Deliver a valid skolenærvær message to SkoleService

scenarios.given: SkoleService answers that the request was received
scenarios.then: a positive application receipt is sent, as the skolenærvær receipt policy requires, and the MU message is completed.

story.title: Reject structurally invalid messages without losing track of them

scenarios.given: a skolenærvær message that violates the v2.0.1 schema
scenarios.then: it is not forwarded, the MU message is completed, and a rejection is recorded with message id, message type, version and reason, without any payload content.

story.title: Reject structurally invalid messages without losing track of them

scenarios.given: a skolenærvær message in a version other than v2.0.1 (for example v2.0.0 or v0.8.2)
scenarios.then: it is rejected as "unsupported version" and never validated against another version.

story.title: Search for a Child

scenarios.given: the caseworker is on the child search page
scenarios.when: they type a child's name in the search field
scenarios.then: a list of matching children appears with name, age, birth date, and current case status

story.title: Search for a Child

scenarios.given: the caseworker is on the child search page
scenarios.when: they type a BiRK-ID in the search field
scenarios.then: the matching child appears in the results

story.title: View Child Profile Overview

scenarios.given: a child has complete identity data
scenarios.then: name, age, gender, birth number, BiRK-ID, home municipality, and uncertain-birth-number indicator are all shown

story.title: View Child Profile Overview

scenarios.given: a child has current measures and events
scenarios.then: the "Gjeldende tiltak/opphold" and "Siste hendelser" panels each display the relevant items with their overline label, title, and supporting text

story.title: Filter the Child's Event Timeline

scenarios.given: a child has a mix of event types
scenarios.then: the timeline shows all events newest-first with "Vis alle" active

story.title: Source service delivers a leselogg event

scenarios.given: a valid `LeseloggHendelse` with a unique `hendelsesId` is published to the `leselogg` queue
scenarios.then: the file `{year}/{month}/{day}/{hendelsesId}.json` exists in Blob Storage with content identical to the received event (no transformation).

story.title: Source service delivers a leselogg event

scenarios.given: a valid event has been processed
scenarios.when: the event is acknowledged to Service Bus
scenarios.then: the event is removed from the queue.

story.title: Idempotent handling of a duplicate event

scenarios.given: a `LeseloggHendelse` with an already stored `hendelsesId` is received again
scenarios.then: Blob Storage returns HTTP 412, the event is acknowledged to Service Bus without error, and no new file is created.

story.title: Continuous Event Stream Processing

scenarios.given: a new `TvangsProtokoll` record appears in the Event Hubs stream
scenarios.then: a `Inngrep` event is created in Hendelsestjenesten with all mandatory fields correctly populated.

story.title: Continuous Event Stream Processing

scenarios.given: a new `Rømming` record with `RommingKategoriType = 1` appears
scenarios.then: a `Uteblivelse` event is created with the correct `HendelsesTypeId` and `RommingsDetalj`.

story.title: Child Resolution via Tjeneste Lookup

scenarios.given: a BiRK event with `BirkTiltakPK = 12345`
scenarios.then: the event is delivered to Hendelsestjenesten with both fields populated.

story.title: Correct Terminology in Event Classification

scenarios.given: a caller requests the available event types
scenarios.when: they inspect the runaway event entry
scenarios.then: the label reads "Rømning" (not "Rømming")

story.title: Correct Terminology in Event Classification

scenarios.given: an event classified as a runaway is stored and later retrieved
scenarios.when: the event type label is read
scenarios.then: it reads "Rømning" (not "Rømming")
